item.description:

Each individual triangle TiT_i may thus be parametrised as: 𝐫(u,v)=Ti0+uΔ1+vΔ2\mathbf{r}(u, v) = T_{i0} + u\Delta_1 + v\Delta_2 𝐫u=Δ1\mathbf{r}_u = \Delta_1 𝐫v=Δ2\mathbf{r}_v = \Delta_2 𝐫u×𝐫v=Δ1×Δ2\mathbf{r}_u \times \mathbf{r}_v = \Delta_1 \times \Delta_2 Thus, the surface integral can be rewritten in terms of this parametrisation, substituting in the definition of 𝐅\mathbf{F} as needed: V=∑i=0∬Ti𝐅(x,y,z)(𝐫u×𝐫v)dAV = \sum_{i = 0} \iint_{T_i} \mathbf{F}(x, y, z) (\mathbf{r}_u \times \mathbf{r}_v) dA =∑i=0∬Ti𝐅(x,y,z)(̇Δi1×Δi2)dA= \sum_{i = 0} \iint_{T_i} \mathbf{F}(x, y, z) \dot (\Delta_{i1} \times \Delta_{i2}) dA =∑i=0∬Ti<x,0,0>(̇Δi1×Δi2)dA= \sum_{i = 0} \iint_{T_i} <x, 0, 0> \dot (\Delta_{i1} \times \Delta_{i2}) dA This cross product is constant throughout the triangle and easy to calculate from the vertex data. item.title: EPA says power for data centers can sidestep pollution laws
item.description:
📝 Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) issued guidance clarifying that the Clean Air Act (CAA) Acid Rain Program (ARP) does not apply to power generation facilities that are not connected to a public electricity grid, commonly referred to as “islanded” power generation facilities. The guidance expands opportunities for companies to develop and operate islanded power generation facilities for data centers. Because “islanded” power generation facilities neither sell electricity nor have required reporting to DOE, EPA has concluded that these facilities are not subject to the ARP.
🔗 Read more: https://www.epa.gov/newsreleases/epa-issues-permitting-guidance-further-president-trumps-agenda-promoting-data-centers

item.title: The Twelve-Factor App
item.description:
📝 Introduction In the modern era, software is commonly delivered as a service: called web apps, or software-as-a-service. The twelve-factor app is a methodology for building software-as-a-service apps that: Use declarative formats for setup automation, to minimize time and cost for new developers joining the project; Have a clean contract with the underlying operating system, offering maximum portability between execution environments; Are suitable for deployment on modern cloud platforms, obviating the need for servers and systems administration; Minimize divergence between development and production, enabling continuous deployment for maximum agility; And can scale up without significant changes to tooling, architecture, or development practices. The twelve-factor methodology can be applied to apps written in any programming language, and which use any combination of backing services (database, queue, memory cache, etc).
🔗 Read more: https://12factor.net/

item.title: Advertisers Could Soon Demand 'Verified Clicks'
item.description:
📝 ” As reported by AMO earlier this year, bot clicks, which were thought to only be a problem with corporate email inboxes, are infiltrating consumer inboxes and newsletters. It is typically generated by the email provider’s security systems, which do pre-fetching and scanning of links before an email gets delivered. The report, which leverages its own first-party data from messages delivered to 126 mailbox providers across six regions as well as third-party data from other email service providers (ESPs) that route through Omnivery’s bot detection API, reveals more about what is going on under the hood.

item.title: 대화형 워해머 40k 은하계 지도 - Cartographia Imperialis
ALMA는 베텔게우스의 버블링 표면에서 오래 지속되는 핫스팟을 밝힙니다.
item.description:
📝 2023년 관측치를 2015년에 얻은 유사한 ALMA 데이터와 비교했을 때, 눈에 띄는 북동쪽 핫스팟은 거의 동일한 위치에 비슷한 강도로 나타났습니다. ALMA를 사용한 지속적인 고해상도 관측을 통해 핫스팟이 고정되어 있는지 여부와 이것이 대류, 질량 손실 및 별의 확장된 대기 구조와 어떤 관련이 있는지 밝힐 수 있습니다. 출처: ALMA(ESO/NAOJ/NRAO)/W.
🔤 Original: ALMA Reveals Long-Lived Hotspots on Betelgeuse's Bubbling Surface
